segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Hi Adesh ji, so this month we have a great lineup. Tata Tea Premium has a new pack. Muggie has a combo offer, and Aashirvaad has a festive pack. And I really think your customers will love all of these, because the festive season is coming and everyone is stocking up. So you should take a bigger order this time.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: स्नेहा। The Tata tea price hike last month, customers are not happy. Sales are down almost twenty percent.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Yes, but the quality is premium and the brand is very strong, and we are also running a TV campaign. So customers will come back and, honestly, the new pack looks very good on the shelf, so I would say take at least fifty cases this month.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: I am still sitting on old stock. People are buying the cheaper local tea now.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Ok, but Maggi is doing very well everywhere, so for Maggi, you should definitely take more. Maybe forty cases, and the combo will move fast.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Muggy is fine. Muggy always sells. Give me thirty cases of muggy Tata tea, only ten.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Ok, thirty Maggi and ten Tata tea, and Mom's magic.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: No, Mom's magic is too expensive for our customers.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Alright, I will send the order today, delivery by Thursday.
